title: Yaar Enda Mani-Evade Subrahm
desc: Driven by unrelenting ambition, Nani sets out on a transformative quest to the Himalayas, compelled by the tragic loss of his childhood friend and a series of daunting challenges.

title: Run Baby Run
desc: A man reluctantly agrees to help a medical student who is in trouble by sheltering her in his apartment. However, trouble ensues when she is found dead the next morning.

title: Romeo
desc: Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

title: Inttelligent
desc: A successful software engineer becomes a vigilante following the demise of his mentor in a bid to seek revenge against those responsible for the latter's death.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.

title: Kalyana Samayal Saadham
desc: Raghu, a software engineer, faces several challenges in his arranged marriage as he suffers from erectile dysfunction and tries to find a solution to his problem.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: 100 Days of Love
desc: A columnist reunites with his childhood rival and unexpectedly falls in love. However, just as he gathers the courage to confess, he discovers that she is engaged to another.

title: Theeya Velai Seiyyanum Kumaru
desc: Kumar falls for Sanjana and seeks guidance from Mokia, a love guru, to win her heart. However, things take a dramatic turn when Sanjana turns out to be Mokia's sister.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Lucky Baskhar
desc: Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.

title: Nadungaadhey Illathil Pei
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Aaru Adi Bullet
desc: A young man is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.
